record.question: Make haste lest you should not be caught in the storm.
record.explanation: Answer C: you should be. “Lest” already means “for fear that”; a negative after it is redundant in this intended construction. “Lest you should be caught” is grammatical. Independent check: “Lest” already means “for fear that”; the intended construction is “lest you should be caught,” without the source’s extra “not,” which reverses the intended sense. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/lest. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
